origins.section: A Stream Over a File Holds It Open Until close(), Not Until the Terminal Operation
A Collection's Stream Has the Collection's Order, and a HashSet Has None
Stream.of Streams Its Arguments: an int[] Is One Element, and So Is null
A Generated Sequence Ends Only Where Its Factory Says
Builder and concat Assemble a Stream; Repeated concat Overflows the Stack

gates.says: all 5 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-archive-sweep: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-archive-sweep: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-archive-sweep: Page: "A terminal operation finishes the pipeline; only `close()` releases what the source holds" and "The leaked ones do close eventually ... So the garbage collector decides when your files close. With `ulimit -n 512`, the same loop failed partway" (FileSystemException: Too many open files). 6,000 files against a 4,096 limit is the same situation, so option a follows.
recorded.prompt:q-oldest-key: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-oldest-key: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-oldest-key: "A `HashSet` has no encounter order: its spliterator doesn't report `ORDERED`, and what you see is its bucket layout. The set held the same five codes both times, but resizing for 20 temporary entries moved them, and `findFirst()` changed from `bravo` to `delta`."
recorded.prompt:q-blocked-ports: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-blocked-ports: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-blocked-ports: "An `int[]` isn't a `T[]`, so `Stream.of(ports)` picks `of(T t)` with `T = int[]`: a stream of one array"; output "Stream.of(ports).contains 8080?   = false"; "an array never equals an `Integer`".
recorded.prompt:q-tripling: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-tripling: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-tripling: "`Stream.iterate(seed, next)` never ends ... A filter doesn't end a stream, it only drops elements" and "The doubling overflows to `-2147483648`, then to `0`, and `0 < 1000` passes forever." The page shows doubling, not tripling, so the reader has to carry the overflow-passes-the-filter point over to n * 3 (wrapped negative products pass n < 500).
recorded.prompt:q-page-concat: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-page-concat: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-page-concat: Output "100000 concats: StackOverflowError in concat"; "each `concat` in a loop wraps the previous result"; "The `concat` javadoc warns that deep concatenation can end in `StackOverflowError`."
